change to:

issue_context.title: br: add flag to control whether restore priv table on default
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
add flag `--with-sys-table` to control whether restore priv table on default for full/point restore.

and when restore priv table we'll skip clearing and restoring user `cloud_admin` since it's a special user on cloud.

for the feature `restore system priv tables`, ref https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/35395

review_comments: I think you can add a comment to describe the meaning of the map value.
